name: hou_mcp_build_structure
description: Generate the structural elements of an environment (floor, walls, ceiling) without openings or beams. Returns a flat JSON list of StructuralElements with tx/ty/tz/dimensions/material ready for Houdini node creation.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment_realization import get_structural_builder

class Hou_Mcp_Build_Structure(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_build_structure"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("environment", "string", widget_type="text", default="western_room")
        self.add_output("elements_json")
        self.add_output("wall_count",  "int")
        self.add_output("room_closed", "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        env = (inputs.get("environment") or "").strip() or "western_room"
        try:
            plan = get_structural_builder().build(env)
            # Return only structural (non-opening) elements
            structural = [e.to_dict() for e in plan.structural_elements if not e.is_opening]
            return {
                "elements_json": json.dumps(structural, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "wall_count":    plan.wall_count,
                "room_closed":   plan.room_closed,
                "exec_out":      True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Structural build failed: {exc}")
            return {"elements_json": "[]", "wall_count": 0, "room_closed": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Build_Structure
